summary: Iteration 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 38/38 pytest cases pass including new Ingest Key Guard (401 without header, 401 with wrong key, 200 with correct key), /api/ingest/key-hint (200 for TENANT_ADMIN with masked hint 'xxxxxx…yyyy'+length, 403 for CXO), /api/dashboard/cxo-comparison (3 plants Pune/Mumbai/Nashik, all required KPI fields, ordered by OEE desc, deterministic across calls), /api/operator/my-machine (CNC-DEMO-01 + Pune Plant for operator, 403 for admin), /api/operator/production (updates production_count/good_count/reject_count upward, 403 for admin), /api/escalations returns list. Escalation flow verified end-to-end using ESCALATION_MINUTES=0: fresh CRITICAL alarm ingested → escalation entry appeared within seconds, alarm.escalated=true set on GET /api/alarms. Frontend: CXO login lands on /cxo, CXO board shows Fleet KPIs, OEE bar chart (recharts svg), radar chart, and Plant leaderboard with 3 rows [cxo-row-PUN-01, cxo-row-MUM-01, cxo-row-NSK-01]; CXO sidebar has 'CXO Board' + Assets + Asset Hierarchy (no Dashboard); CXO /dashboard redirects back to /cxo; CXO can access /assets (shows 62 assets across all areas). Operator login lands on /operator with no sidebar (BareProtected), CNC-DEMO-01 status card + 5 big metric cards + Log Production form + Active Alarms panel; submitting produced=5/good=5 shows toast '+5 pcs logged', resets inputs to 0, and increases Total 642→647 / Good 627→632; seeded alarm appeared in Active Alarms list and clicking Acknowledge removed it; /dashboard and /assets both redirect back to /operator. Tenant Admin lands on /dashboard, sidebar has both Dashboard + CXO Board, header ShieldAlert bell shows red numeric badge (4) and dropdown 'Auto-Escalations' lists recent escalations. Regression: total_assets now 62 (45 Pune + 8 Mumbai + 8 Nashik + a couple test-created), Assets list works, Asset Hierarchy still returns 3 plants, WebSocket telemetry still flows.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx navFor(): for TENANT_ADMIN the item order is Dashboard then CXO Board (line 20 then 21). Ordering is fine, but note that for CXO the same 'CXO Board' entry is defined at line 19; consider consolidating so both roles use a single source of truth.

OperatorRunbook subscribe effect depends on `data` and re-subscribes on every telemetry tick, which will churn the WS listener each second. Consider using a ref for `data.asset.id` or gating with data?.asset?.id in the dependency.

cxo-comparison KPIs (oee/availability/performance/quality/energy_kwh/carbon) are deterministic mocks seeded off plant code — that is fine for demo but should be flagged as 'not real KPIs' in the UI to avoid CXO confusion in production.
escalation_scanner runs an unbounded find on {escalated:{$ne:true}} + old created_at with no created_at index; add an index on (tenant_id, severity, acknowledged, created_at) for scale.
server.py is now 1241 lines. Consider splitting routers into /telemetry.py, /operator.py, /cxo.py, /escalations.py to keep the single-file boundary under 700 lines as per the guideline.

Ingest key stored in backend/.env is written by ensure_ingest_key() on first boot; make sure the deployment layer treats .env as source-of-truth and doesn't overwrite (else all Node-RED flows break silently).
server.py includes ObjectId `_id` exclusions with {'_id':0} projections throughout — good practice already applied.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows across CXO, Operator, Tenant Admin

test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Tenant SBF, all 5 roles). INGEST_KEY read from /app/backend/.env (masked, do not log).
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeded Pune (45 assets)+Mumbai(8)+Nashik(8)=61 assets + a couple TEST-* assets from prior create test → dashboard total_assets=62. Iteration 2 test file adds no permanent seed. Escalation test used ESCALATION_MINUTES=0 temporarily then removed; scanner now back to default 5 min.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Updated /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now includes X-Ingest-Key header on every /telemetry/ingest call (INGEST_KEY read from /app/backend/.env). Total assets assertion loosened to >=45 to account for Mumbai+Nashik+test-created. For escalation testing, temporarily add ESCALATION_MINUTES=0 to /app/backend/.env, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, then remove the line after test. If ESCALATION_MINUTES=0 is left in place the auto-escalator will keep escalating every CRITICAL alarm every 30s which changes ack/escalations counts.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All four iteration-2 features (Operator Runbook, CXO Comparison Board, Alarm Auto-Escalation, Ingest Key Guard) are implemented correctly and integrated with the frontend.
